# Test photo

`blue-spirit.webp` (800 × 800) is a product photo of House of Morais "Blue Spirit" Eau de Parfum pour homme, 100 ml,
supplied by the project owner for the demo screenshots.

`tests/browser-test.js` uploads it (scaled up to 2400 px, so the page has to shrink it) and uses it for the
README screenshots. The sample listing in `tests/mock-anthropic.php` describes this perfume, using only what is
visible in the photo or printed on the box and bottle.
